title: P3 - S3 git layer self-heals duplicate-bundle ref collisions (quarantine + prune) so one raced push cannot freeze a namespace mirror forever
reasoning: Filed while repairing the live incident (OPS-009, tick 529). The S3 git-history layer has NO self-heal for the git-remote-s3 duplicate-bundle ref collision, so ONE raced push freezes a namespace mirror FOREVER. Live evidence 2026-09-18: scheduler (2 master bundles, frozen since 09-16 03:56Z), default (frozen since 09-15 17:15Z), hermes-canopy (frozen since 09-18 03:19Z) - every `git push s3daily` refused with 'dst refspec refs/heads/master matches more than one' (client-side) / 'multiple bundles exists on server' (helper-side), while the native 15-min layer kept syncing (the trap: data looks backed up). The daily layer logged FAIL push for those namespaces on 09-16, 09-17 and 09-18 with the failing set GROWING 2 -> 3. ROOT CAUSE: git-remote-s3 stores a ref as <prefix>/<repo>/refs/heads/<branch>/<tipsha>.bundle, one object per tip; two pushes that each see <=1 bundle write two different tip bundles under the same ref path. The per-ref LOCK#.lock (IfNoneMatch conditional PUT) did not prevent it on this S3-compatible endpoint (default namespace carries a 0-byte LOCK#.lock from the same second as its duplicate pair, and the duplicate survived under it), so mutual exclusion cannot be relied on - the layer must converge by DETECTING and REPAIRING the collision. FIX (pre-verified recipe, off-by-one answer 1660 class git-remote-s3-duplicate-bundle-ref-collision): inside the per-namespace push loop, before `git push`, list the objects under the ref path; if >1 bundle: keeper = the key whose sha equals the local ref tip if present else newest LastModified; for each other bundle require its sha exist LOCALLY as a commit (never delete unverifiable data), copy it to quarantine/git/<ns>/<branch>/<sha>.bundle (size-verified) and delete it from the ref path; assert exactly one survivor; log loudly; a repair is not a failure (exit-code contract of S3-GIT-002 unchanged). Skip the whole guard for non-s3:// URL templates (the hermetic harness uses file://) and when a git-remote-s3 helper is already running (a concurrent push can write a THIRD bundle). ACCEPTANCE: hermetic harness (stub `aws` on PATH) proves (a) 2 bundles -> 1 quarantine copy + 1 ref-path delete + push proceeds, (b) stale sha missing locally -> no delete, loud skip, (c) 1 bundle -> zero repair calls, (d) file:// template -> guard skipped with zero aws calls; the existing scripts/s3/test-push-backoff.sh stays green; README documents the quarantine path and the rollback copy. NO live S3 mutation and NO deployment to ~/.hermes/scripts from the worker - the foreman deploys after verification.
